title: Millicharged particles, strongly interacting massive relics and other exotic heavy particles as the source of a single 248 keV xenon recoil
question: Could an exotic heavy relic other than a WIMP-like particle (millicharged, SIMP/composite, nuclearite/Q-ball, CHAMP, monopole, superheavy/Planck-scale, dark nucleus) produce exactly one ~248 keV single-site NR in 2.84 t yr with no low-energy companions and no veto activity?
headline_result: No exotic heavy relic reproduces the lone recoil: halo millicharged particles (eps_1 = 1.7e-8 at 1 TeV) imply N_lo = 2.3e5-7.7e5 low-energy companions, pointlike SIMPs 676-2270, and the only spectrum with acceptable N_lo (opaque composite, sigma ~ 8e-25 cm^2, m ~ 1e17 GeV, N_lo = 1.43) predicts 3.2 events in 55-200 keV plus 1.65 in LZ's zero-event HE sideband per window event (P(0) = 0.008) and 8 multi-scatter traversals; tracks, monopoles and Planck-scale relics fail on dE/dx or flux (F = 2.2e-13 cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1, m <= 3.9e18 p GeV)
key_numbers: MCP N_lo 2.3e5/7.7e5 (Helm/shell, 1 TeV), 6.6e6 (100 GeV); eps_1 1.7e-8 = sigma_SI 4.5e-42 cm^2; relativistic MCP N_lo 9.6e4/3.2e5, 4400 ER per NR; sigma(lambda=97 cm) 7.75e-25 cm^2; P1 max 0.31, P(>=2) 0.27; flat spectrum N_lo 1.43, N(55-200) 3.17, N(HESB 375-732 keV) 1.65, P(0) 0.0081; m(N=1) 1.1e17 (flat) / 1.0e15 GeV (pointlike); rock transparent > 3.7e3 / 1.2e6 GeV; F(N=1) 2.19e-13 cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1 (219x Parker, 1564x MACRO); m <= 3.86e18 p GeV, Planck mass 0.32 traversals; nuclearite 2.8 TeV/cm, CHAMP 74 MeV/cm, monopole 2-12 MeV/cm; delta_max -> 405 keV, R_D < 0.8 fm
model_or_mechanism: Rutherford MCP scattering; heavy-limit flat/F^2 recoil spectra with SHM eta; chord MC single/multiple-scatter probabilities; Rutherford + Lindhard stopping; isotropic flux ceiling
confidence: high for spectral exclusions; medium for stopping powers and recalled limits
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13, numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, pandas 3.0.5, matplotlib 3.11.2, nestpy 2.1.1 (via lzcommon), common/lzcommon.py, WimPyDD 2.0.4 (P017 cached shell table)
